actions.name: stack-access-show
actions.label: Show external access
actions.description: Shows the URL, the user name and the password of the basic auth in front of this stack.

actions.name: stack-access-rotate
actions.label: Rotate external password
actions.description: Makes a new password for the basic auth in front of this stack.
actions.confirm: The old password stops working within a few seconds. People who use it must get the new password.

actions.name: stack-access-set
actions.label: Turn external password on or off
actions.description: Turns the basic auth in front of this stack on or off. Off: everybody who knows the URL can open the stack.
